heading: INT. GENERATION SHIP "KESTREL" - CARGO HOLD C - NIGHT SHIFT

units.text: INT. GENERATION SHIP "KESTREL" - CARGO HOLD C - NIGHT SHIFT
Stacked cryo-crates.
Condensation drips from the ceiling.
Cold light, long shadows.
A hatch in the far wall is sealed with yellow tape.
TOMASZ, 50, crew chief, in a quilted jacket, leans against a crate.
REN, 20s, logistics, holds a tablet.
ASTRID, 40, a medic, kneels beside a cracked cryo-pod.
BASHIR, 30s, an engineer, stands at the sealed hatch with a wrench.
Count again.
units.name: TOMASZ

units.text: Two hundred twelve.
units.name: REN

units.text: Two hundred eleven. This one's empty.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: Two hundred ten. I counted the manifest.
units.name: BASHIR

units.text: You don't count the manifest. You count the pods.
units.name: TOMASZ

units.text: The manifest says two hundred twelve.
units.name: REN

units.text: The manifest is old.
units.name: BASHIR

units.text: This pod isn't cracked from the outside.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: What do you mean?
units.name: REN

units.text: The glass bowed out. Someone woke up in here.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: Nobody wakes up. We don't wake until arrival.
units.name: TOMASZ

units.text: Then someone did.
units.name: BASHIR

units.text: Then someone's in this ship we don't know about.
units.name: TOMASZ

units.text: That's impossible.
units.name: REN

units.text: So is the pod.
units.name: ASTRID

units.text: The hatch is taped from the inside.
units.name: BASHIR

units.text: They all turn to him.
He taps the yellow tape with the wrench.
It is peeled from the inside edge.
Open it.
units.name: TOMASZ

units.text: I'd rather not.
units.name: BASHIR

units.text: Open it.
units.name: TOMASZ

units.text: I'd rather you didn't.
units.name: BASHIR

units.text: Behind the hatch, someone knocks, once.
Politely.
